fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2014 by approximately $60.8 million. As of December 31, 2014, we had jet fuel option agreements in place to protect 88.7 million gallons, or approximately 35% of our 2015 anticipated fuel consumption.

instrument_type_details.notes: Jet fuel option agreements protecting 88.7 million gallons at $2.07/gal ceiling price for 2015. Also uses interest rate swaps for aircraft financing (not fuel hedges).

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed 200,498 [2014] 171,931 [2013] [from 2014 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]; Aircraft fuel expense increased by 11.1% from $551.7 million in 2013 to $612.9 million in 2014 due to a 16.6% increase in fuel gallons consumed.
